en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a town nestled at the base of bare hills or low mountains. The foreground is filled with dense traditional low-rise houses with tiled roofs and a few taller religious buildings, including a church with a bell tower. The style and print resemble an early 20th‑century photographic postcard, with printed captions in French and Latin characters along the bottom margin.
